# README image provenance

`evidence-review.webp` is an AI-generated editorial photograph, created on
2026-10-12. It depicts people comparing an advisory, a patch diff, and proof
notes beside a closed laptop and hardware security key. The image contains no
product interface, readable security claims, customer data, or claim that these
people are the project's maintainers.

The subject comes from the live site's bounded remediation and reviewer
workflow:

- https://security-recipes.ai/security-remediation/
- https://security-recipes.ai/security-remediation/reviewer-playbook/
- https://security-recipes.ai/mcp-servers/

The live homepage and those content areas were inspected with the web reader.
The environment's network gateway returned HTTP 403 to direct HTTPS fetches,
preventing current live browser screenshots. The old README hero, social card,
and five schematic workflow illustrations were inspected and removed from the
README. The legacy `docs/screenshots/home.png` depicts an older homepage and
was unsuitable as a current screenshot. Existing site illustrations remain
available on the site.

The source PNG was 1,970,281 bytes. The README asset is a 1672 × 941 WebP,
encoded at quality 82 without changing its composition. Its pixels were
inspected after encoding. Badges became text links so every README image is
themed photography. Do not relabel this photo as a website screenshot.
